_about: MagicMenuRewrite strings, English - the magic menu's own texts (preview box, spell card, layout key hints) and the fallback for any key another language file lacks; a key missing here too shows the plugin's built-in English. Keep the {placeholders} and the ' · ' separators as they are.
settings_lang_note: Applies the next time the magic menu opens.
settings_lang_titles: Add-on block titles and this tab's name change after restarting the game.
settings_blocks_note: Unticked blocks are hidden in the magic menu, but keep their positions in the layout. Applies the next time the magic menu opens.
settings_blocks_builtin: When Spell card is off, SkyUI's item card appears in its usual place; when 3D preview is off, the game shows the spell's 3D model in its default place.
